code.title: Baby Senses Lab
code.text: Developmental world models with one network per sense, each fed age-filtered input, plus a public site that shows a photo, video or sound the way a baby of a chosen age might sense it.

code.title: Digital Twin History
code.text: An open, cited history of digital twins and physical AI, from andon lights and Apollo's simulators to live factory twins and AI world models. Dataset and interactive site.

code.title: Michelin Kitchen Twin
code.text: A browser-based 3D twin of a three-star kitchen running a full dinner service, modeled like a manufacturing plant: covers are the build plan, every plate a bill of materials.

code.title: Auto-Twin
code.text: From a walkthrough video to a live digital twin: a world-model splat converted to OpenUSD, bound to cloud telemetry and rendered in the browser, Blender or Omniverse.

code.title: LabTrends
code.text: An offline, privacy-first Android app that turns scattered lab reports into per-person health trends, with on-device OCR and a small local model. No cloud, no accounts.

code.title: India Iceberg Index
code.text: Maps how exposed India's workforce is to generative AI, district by district, by combining occupational AI-exposure scores with national labor survey data.
